_comment: Hand-edited top-level metadata for patterns.json. Bumped per the Versioning protocol when a release ships. The patterns.json output file is regenerated from this + the .md files in components/ by website/scripts/generate-patterns-json.js (runs in prebuild).
_comment_order_overrides: Patterns default to alphabetical filename order, which also drives the sidebar. Each [earlierId, laterId] pair pins earlierId immediately before laterId. snackbar.basic ("Snackbar") must precede snackbar.action ("Snackbar with Action"), the reverse of the alphabetical order, matching web's toast.basic / toast.action.
